I identified customers who show at least one order in every calendar quarter of 2025 (Q1 through Q4) but had zero additional order lines recorded after 2025-12-31 (i.e., no 2026 activity), using cumulative order_line counts as of each quarter-end boundary.

Method: for each party, compared cumulative order_line count as_of 2024-12-31 (baseline, zero for everyone), 2025-03-31, 2025-06-30, 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, and today. A customer qualifies if each quarter's cumulative count grew over the prior boundary (bought that quarter) and the count as_of today equals the count as_of 2025-12-31 (no 2026 growth).

Only two customers, out of 283 total in the dataset, satisfy both conditions:

- Ana Lund (party:8886536c): order lines 16→30→43→57 across 2025 Q1→Q4 (growth each quarter), still 57 as of today, no 2026 orders.
- Cara Novak (party:8b1f5466): order lines 2→4→7→10 across 2025 Q1→Q4 (growth each quarter), still 10 as of today, no 2026 orders.

All other customers either missed at least one 2025 quarter or placed at least one order line in 2026.

ANSWER: Only two customers bought in all four calendar quarters of 2025 and have placed no orders in 2026: Ana Lund and Cara Novak. Every other customer in the dataset either skipped a 2025 quarter or has already ordered in 2026.
